mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'logIn' THEN 1 END) AS logIn, COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'sampled' THEN 1 END) AS sampled, COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'inspected' THEN 1 END) AS inspected, COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'weighed' THEN 1 END) AS weighed, COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'warehoused' THEN 1 END) AS warehoused, COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'tareWeighed' THEN 1 END) AS tareWeighed, COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'pendCard' THEN 1 END) + COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'settled' THEN 1 END) AS pendCard FROM task_flow where job_type = 1 -- WHERE -- DATE(add_time) = CURRENT_DATE

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'logIn' THEN 1 END) AS logIn, -- COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'sampled' THEN 1 END) AS sampled, -- COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'inspected' THEN 1 END) AS inspected, COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'weighed' THEN 1 END) AS weighed, COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'warehoused' THEN 1 END) AS warehoused, COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'tareWeighed' THEN 1 END) AS tareWeighed, COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'pendCard' THEN 1 END) + COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'settled' THEN 1 END) AS pendCard FROM task_flow where job_type = 2 -- WHERE -- DATE(add_time) = CURRENT_DATE

select tf.id as id, tf.job_no as jobNo, sc.name as customerName, CASE WHEN tf.job_type = 1 THEN (select bdd.label from task_flow_quality_item tfqi left join base_dict_data bdd on bdd.type = 'GRAIN_GRADE' and bdd.description = tfqi.grain_grade::varchar where tfqi.task_id = tf.id)
WHEN tf.job_type = 2 THEN (select bdd.label from warehouse_out_order woo left join sts_warehouse sw on woo.warehouse_id = sw.id left join base_dict_data bdd on bdd.type = 'GRAIN_GRADE' and bdd.description = sw.grain_grade::varchar where woo.id = tf.order_id) ELSE '' -- 其他类型默认0（可根据业务调整） END as grainLevel, CASE WHEN tf.job_type = 1 THEN ( select bdd.label from warehouse_in_order wio left join base_dict_data bdd on bdd.type = 'GRAIN_VARIETY' and bdd.description = wio.grain_variety::varchar where wio.id = tf.order_id ) WHEN tf.job_type = 2 THEN ( select bdd.label from warehouse_out_order woo left join sts_warehouse sw on woo.warehouse_id = sw.id left join base_dict_data bdd on bdd.type = 'GRAIN_VARIETY' and bdd.description = sw.grain_variety::varchar where woo.id = tf.order_id ) ELSE '' END as grainVariety, CASE WHEN tf.job_type = 1 THEN (select weight from task_flow_weight_item where task_id = tf.id and weight_type = 1) - (select weight from task_flow_weight_item where task_id = tf.id and weight_type = 2) WHEN tf.job_type = 2 THEN (select weight from task_flow_weight_item where task_id = tf.id and weight_type = 1) - (select weight from task_flow_weight_item where task_id = tf.id and weight_type = 2) ELSE 0 -- 其他类型默认0（可根据业务调整） END as netWeight, -- 定义皮重/毛重的子查询 (select weight from task_flow_weight_item where task_id = tf.id and weight_type = 2) as tareWeight, (select weight from task_flow_weight_item where task_id = tf.id and weight_type = 1) as grossWeight, CASE WHEN tf.job_type = 1 THEN '入库' WHEN tf.job_type = 2 THEN '出库' ELSE '其他' END as jobType, tfbi.balance_weight as settleWeight, tfbi.balance_price as settleUnitPrice, tfbi.balance_amount as settleAmount, tf.carrier_name as carrier, tfbi.pre_deduct_weight as deductionPerKg, tfbi.scene_deduct_weight as onSiteDeduction, tfbi.price as standardUnitPrice, tfbi.pre_deduct_weight as deductionPricePerKg, tfbi.deduct_weight_total as totalDeductionWeight, tfbi.id_card as accountIdCard, tfbi.link_phone as accountPhone, tfbi.bank_name as bankName, tfbi.bank_code as bankCode, tfbi.bank_account as bankAccount, tfbi.add_time as settleTime from task_flow tf left join sts_customer sc on tf.customer_id = sc.id left join task_flow_quality_item tfqi on tf.id = tfqi.task_id left join task_flow_balance_item tfbi on tf.id = tfbi.task_id where tf.id = #{id}
